d:
Major Rishabh Singh Sambyal, Ex-Special Forces officer and former ADC to the President of India, on fear, discipline, and serving at the very top.
He explains:
• What it actually takes to survive Para SF selection, 90 days with no food, water, or sleep
• How to become President of India ADC selection process interviews tests
• Why he believes courage cannot exist without fear, and what that means for real combat
• What an ADC does that most people never know, anticipating every need before it arises
• How special forces soldier deals with fear in combat
